title: Quote: (of his generation) We wanted to more richly experience why ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: (of his generation) We wanted to more richly experience why were we were alive, not just make a better life, and so people went in search of things. The great thing that came from those that time was to realize that there was definitely more to life than the materialism of the late 50's and early sixties. We were going in search of something deeper.
